title: Find and replace across chapters
searching: Searching manuscripts and building a read-only preview…
searchCancelled: Stopped waiting. A bounded read-only search already running may finish, but cannot change text. Only one search per novel may be in flight; retry manually shortly.
progress: Pending {{pending}} · Replaced {{applied}} · Skipped by author {{skipped}} · Identical {{unchanged}}
noFilteredResults: No candidates in this filter. Switch to all statuses to see the rest.
skippedSummary: Skipped {{count}} candidates without changing text. Deferred names are not counted as author skips.
restoredSummary: Returned {{count}} candidates to pending without changing text.
namesDeferred: Another {{count}} name candidates await review. They were neither replaced nor marked skipped.
recheckNames: Name ranges are recalculated after each write. Existing protection is never silently removed within this preview; review inclusion again.
noHistory: No replacement batches yet. Skipping candidates alone does not create empty undo records.
legacyHistory: Earlier records did not retain search settings. Affected files and revision history remain available.
copyUndoHelp: Undo removes this separate revision draft; the original Final stays unchanged and historical copies remain available
oversizedFile: Skipped: exceeds the existing editor size limit; text was not truncated
skippedFile: Skipped: manuscript could not be read; expand for diagnostics

errors.REPLACE_REGEX_INVALID: The regular expression has a syntax error. Check brackets, character classes, and escaping. No manuscript was changed.
errors.REPLACE_REGEX_TIMEOUT: Search or name protection reached its safety timeout. Simplify the expression or narrow the chapter scope. No manuscript was changed.
errors.REPLACE_ZERO_WIDTH: Zero-width and empty-text matches are not supported. Match actual text to replace.
errors.REPLACE_REVISION_CHANGED: A manuscript version changed and was not forcibly overwritten. Search again or compare revision history.
errors.REPLACE_PREVIEW_EXPIRED: This preview expired, was undone, or became stale. Search again.
errors.REPLACE_SCOPE_INVALID: Choose valid volumes or chapters in this novel. Only manuscript text can be replaced.
errors.REPLACE_ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: The search component is unavailable. Use the complete release or install project dependencies using the developer guide.
errors.REPLACE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: The operation could not fully complete. Later external edits were not overwritten. Review the batch and revision history for recovery.
errors.REQUEST_REJECTED: The operation could not be completed. Check the preview count, selected scope, and manuscript versions before retrying. Expand diagnostics for the cause.
errors.REPLACE_REPLACEMENT_INVALID: The replacement contains an invalid group reference or escape. Check the groups in the search expression. No manuscript was changed.
errors.REPLACE_SEARCH_BUSY: The previous read-only search for this novel is still finishing. Retry manually in a moment; the request will not be replayed automatically.

help: Search this novel’s selected manuscripts, preferring each chapter’s Final, otherwise its draft; use the latest revision only if neither exists. Every replacement requires author confirmation. Finals and committed text produce separate revision drafts.
wholeWordHelp: Uses Unicode letter, number, and underscore boundaries. Continuous Chinese text is one word segment; no linguistic segmentation or AI inference is applied.
regexHelp: Unicode regex syntax. Replacement supports \1, \g<name>, and \n. Zero-width matches are not supported. Errors and timeouts never change text.
namesProtect: Skip character, place, and setting names by default
namesOnly: Match setting names only; skip other text
namesAll: Search all text and warn separately about names
emptyBook: No manuscript yet. Create a chapter or story draft before searching.
coverage: {{matches}} matches found; {{scanned}} of {{total}} manuscript files checked.
partial: Coverage is incomplete. Narrow the scope when a match, time, or size limit is reached. Replace all affects only the matches frozen in this preview.
allowNames: I reviewed the name warnings and allow these replacements ({{count}} matches; Canon itself stays unchanged)
replaceAll: Replace all {{count}} matches in this preview
noMatches: No matches in the checked manuscripts. Try different text or scope.
nameWarning: Original or newly formed names in this preview: {{names}}. Review to avoid unintended character, place, or setting renames.
revisionCopy: Save as a separate revision draft
summary: Replaced {{count}} matches in {{chapters}} manuscript files; skipped {{skipped}}.
undone: The whole batch was undone. Before and after versions remain recoverable from history.
undoHelp: Undo validates every file first. If any file changed after replacement, it will not overwrite it. Compare revision history instead.
confirmCount: Replace {{count}} matches from the frozen preview.
confirmSafety: Drafts use the existing save and version checks. Final or committed manuscripts create separate revision drafts. Unselected chapters remain unchanged.
confirmNames: This batch includes proper names. Confirm the impact; official setting entries are not renamed.
confirmUndoText: Undo {{count}} replacements in this batch only if every target still matches its saved receipt. A pre-undo history copy is retained.
historyUnavailable: Replacement history could not be loaded or refreshed. This does not mean the manuscript operation failed. Keep the current receipt and reopen history later.
previewRefreshIncomplete: The operation receipt was received, but some preview pages could not be reloaded. Only refreshed pages and their selections are retained. Load and review the rest; do not repeat a completed operation.
restoringView: Reloading the frozen preview and checking manuscript versions…
restoredView: Restored {{count}} loaded results and selections. No search or text edit was replayed; names still require review.
restoreExpired: The previous frozen preview expired or was undone. Inputs were restored. Review them and search manually; no action was replayed.
restoreStale: The text, scope, or names changed. The old preview was not restored as executable. Inputs remain; search again manually.
restoreUnavailable: The old preview could not be restored. Inputs remain; no search or write was replayed. Search manually when ready.
viewExpired: The temporary page recovery record is over two hours old. Starting with an empty preview.
filterChaptersPlaceholder: Enter a chapter title or number…
chapterFilterHelp: Filtering changes the list only; hidden selections remain. Search processes the chapters actually selected.
noChapterFilterMatch: No chapters match this filter. Existing selections remain unchanged.
chapterSelectionLimit: Select at most 2,000 chapters at once. Narrow the filter.
searchShortcut: Ctrl+Enter: search and preview only; never replace or bypass confirmation.
intentTooLong: This selection cannot be used. Select 1–300 characters; it will not be truncated, searched, or replaced automatically.
intentChapter: The manuscript selection is ready as literal search text, limited to “{{chapter}}”. Review the options and search when ready. No search or edit has run.
intentBook: The selection is ready as literal search text, but its chapter could not be identified uniquely. Scope is now the whole book; review it before searching. No search or edit has run.
resultKeywordPlaceholder: Filter chapter titles, matches, or visible context…
resultFiltersHelp: Showing {{visible}} of {{loaded}} loaded matches. This filters preview snippets only, without searching the manuscripts again or changing the search scope or selections.
hiddenSelected: {{count}} eligible selected matches are hidden by these filters. Replace selected still includes them. Use “Select visible pending matches only” to narrow the selection.
confirmFilteredAll: Display filters do not limit this operation. Replace all includes pending matches across the entire frozen preview, including those currently hidden.
confirmHiddenSelected: This selection includes {{count}} currently hidden matches. Confirm that they should also be replaced, or cancel and select visible matches only.
